findings.finding: A publication-bound returned findings result can still complete through the generic core-resolution branch with an actual same-grant/mode/executor DG accept answer, bypassing guarded plugin-findings/publication-ledger incorporation. Matching complete stage then counts at readiness while the publication ledger remains empty. A decision to substantiate a future fix therefore becomes pr-ready without an actual fix or dismissal.
findings.proposed_guard: For publication-bound review findings, require a guarded matching ordinary publication contribution/resolution ledger receipt before stage/readiness satisfaction. A legitimate evidence-backed dismissal must remain represented in that ledger; generic accept/resolve without ledger evidence must not satisfy the configured review pass. Keep task/plan generic resolution behavior scoped separately.
findings.regression: Use an actual controlled DG accept/resolve for the exact original review HI/result under the original grant, then verify the generic receipt cannot yield a current completed publication requirement or pr-ready with an empty ledger.

findings.finding: Readiness derives a chain phase from a fixed REVIEW_PHASES alias map, while existing composition supports arbitrary registered operation.plugin_anchors. A valid additional named alias resolves to an owned canonical phase and can run through the actual guard, yet cannot satisfy readiness because the unlisted alias string never equals before/during/after.
findings.proposed_guard: Use the verified frozen event/binding canonical boundary identity when matching the review phase, retaining registered aliases instead of adding an alias-name allowlist.
findings.regression: Register an additional owned named anchor mapped to after in an isolated source copy; complete/attach its real stage, require ordinary core review, and verify current readiness accepts the canonical phase rather than remaining permanently held.

findings.finding: The after phase guard requires only a current full review record/key and does not require its core actionable findings to be resolved. The after pass can therefore run before the approved complete core review/fix cycle. A later evidence-backed core dismissal with no head/provider-snapshot change leaves hook_context equal; completed readiness counts the earlier complete stage without rechecking its sealed core_review_digest.
findings.proposed_guard: Establish the resolved current core review frontier before the after contribution, and preserve the intended phase/currentness check when counting the accepted after stage. Keep existing before/during prefix semantics and ordered plugin contribution behavior separate.
findings.regression: Record a genuine full core report with an unresolved core finding; the after pass cannot be admitted as the required post-cycle contribution. Resolve/dismiss the core finding through the ordinary evidence path without changing head and prove only a properly placed current after pass supplies readiness.
